content.summary: An orbital courier is revealed from eyes to full-body readiness. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One adult identity anchors every reveal level. + The opening detail belongs to the later full body. + Wardrobe removal is physically continuous. + Foot detail reconnects to the same walk. + The final facial gesture closes the staged reveal.
quick_start.recommended_input: Reveal only the amber eyes of one original adult orbital courier through a narrow light slit. She removes the cape and places it on one marked floor square without breaking stride. End on her face with one controlled half-smile and a small salute before the light closes.

usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An orbital courier is revealed from eyes to full-body readiness. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.

not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
